source.description: Later pointwise-localization continuation recovered from the supplied Turn 6 session transcript, after the packaged full-shell tranche.

repairs: Restored the lost radical in the middle-channel split: j <= sqrt(a) or j >= sqrt(a).
Added the complement-fixed case to the Klein-four freeness proof and excluded it by v_p(pa)=1.
Typed the orbit sum-and-difference inverse on its image lattice, including its congruence modulo 4.

checked: middle-channel least-nonresidue localization and hard-prime equalities
exterior boundary-gap, endpoint-excluded strict inequality and reciprocal D bound
free Klein-four source action and unique fundamental representative
p=41, p=1009 and p=2521 exact coordinate examples
two empty minimal p=2521 lanes and the surviving Q=111 state
odd-square two-colour obstruction and its exact information loss
independent_derivation.result: The stated localization theorems and examples are correct after the three explicit presentation repairs.

scope: The result localizes every original E/M state and certifies the declared finite range. It neither proves occupancy of the remaining region nor proves the Erdős--Straus conjecture.
